claims.scope: The text uses can/may, correctly avoiding an iff diagnosis. None can also result from clearing or freezing; zero is not a guarantee of no numerical update because AdamW decay or prior optimizer moments can still act.

issues.details: The categorical opening confuses permission to accumulate new autograd gradients with a prerequisite for optimizer value updates. AdamW consumes retained .grad even after requires_grad=False; the independently executed ordinary-backward-then-freeze counterexample changes1→0.998989999294281. Relevant during the stated phase changes; current code itself correctly filters before optimizer construction.
issues.requested_correction: Qualify the opening to the fresh-gradient autograd workflow; explain that turning requires_grad off does not clear existing .grad, so when retaining an optimizer clear those gradients to None or exclude frozen tensors/rebuild the filtered optimizer.
